RUNBRIDGE AI DOCUMENTATION

Authentication

Treat your API key as a server credential.

Configure your application

Load the key from an environment variable or your server’s secret manager. Your SDK will attach it to the authorization header.

Authorization: Bearer YOUR_API_KEY

Keep secrets out of the client

Do not place a live key in browser JavaScript, public repositories, screenshots or client-side mobile bundles. Route application requests through a server you control.

Rotate a compromised key

Revoke the exposed credential in the account system, create a replacement and update your server configuration. Review recent usage for unexpected requests.

Account-specific configuration

Use the endpoint and model identifier provided for your RunBridge account. Do not assume that a model family name is a valid API model ID.
